description: Reverse affordability: work out the gross monthly income (SGD) needed to support a target property price under Singapore TDSR/MSR limits. Use this when you know the target price; for the budget a known income supports, use `calculate_affordability`.

cashSavings.description: Cash available for downpayment, in SGD.

citizenship.description: Buyer's residency status (Singapore citizen, permanent resident or foreigner); sets the ABSD rate.

cpfOA.description: CPF Ordinary Account balance usable, in SGD.

existingPropertiesOwned.description: Count of residential properties already owned; sets the ABSD tier (0, 1 or 2+). Takes precedence over existingProperty when provided.

existingProperty.description: True if the borrower already owns ≥1 property (affects ABSD and LTV).

interestRate.description: Assumed annual interest rate, as a percentage (e.g. 4.0 = 4%, not 0.04).

monthlyDebt.description: Total existing monthly debt commitments, in SGD.

propertyPrice.description: Target property purchase price, in SGD.

propertyType.description: Type of property: an HDB flat, an Executive Condominium (ec) or private. HDB and EC purchases are also held to the MSR limit.

stressTestRate.description: Override the TDSR/MSR stress-test rate (percentage); defaults to the MAS floor.

name: calculate_required_income

absd.description: Additional Buyer’s Stamp Duty, in SGD.

absdRate.description: ABSD rate applied, as a decimal fraction (0.2 = 20%).

cashShortfall.description: Cash shortfall vs available savings, in SGD (0 if none).

cpfDownpayment.description: CPF applied to downpayment, in SGD.

cpfShortfall.description: CPF shortfall vs available OA, in SGD (0 if none).

isAffordable.description: True if the borrower can fund the purchase with stated means.

ltv.description: Loan-to-value ratio, as a decimal fraction (0.75 = 75%).

maxLoan.description: Loan needed to buy at the target price, in SGD.

minCashPercent.description: Minimum cash portion of price, as a decimal fraction.

monthlyPayment.description: Monthly instalment at that loan, in SGD.

msrRequired.description: Monthly MSR needed (HDB/EC), in SGD; null otherwise.

requiredIncome.description: Gross monthly income required to support it, in SGD.

title: Required-income calculator
